text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: P1 - node provisioning errors across eu-west-1 GPU pool. Multiple new nodes failing to reach Ready state; image pull errors for docker.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime reported in autoscaler logs. Please ack and rotate on-call.
ryan(oncall): Acked. Seeing a bunch of `ErrImagePull` / `unauthorized: authentication required` in the kubelet logs for new instances. Ticketing in progress. @maya.sre are you seeing the same from CI? :eyes:
maya.sre: Yep. CI runners also failing to pull any docker.io images requiring token auth. Quick grep:
```
May 03 04:12:07 kubelet[1234]: E0503 04:12:07.123 kubelet_pod_workers.go:191] CreatePodSandbox for pod "gpu-node-init" failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to pull image "docker.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime": error getting credentials - unauthorized
```
kate.sre: Not just CUDA images — any image that requires registry token returns 401. Public images without token pull okay. Docker Hub token service looks to be returning 401/502 intermittently based on our traces.
aj.infra: Autoscaler is spinning up nodes but cloud-init runs a `docker pull` that hits docker.io token server. If token fetch fails, systemd unit exits non-zero and the node never signals Ready.
lucas.support: Customer impact: Onboarding customers who requested GPU capacity right now will see provisioning failures and queue delays. No existing running GPUs are affected.
ryan(oncall): Live mitigation plan:
- Failover pulls to our internal artifact mirror `artifact-mirror.internal` for nvidia/cuda images (we have cached CUDA images for recent tags).
- Patch cluster bootstrap to use mirror for docker.io/nvidia/* until Docker Hub auth stabilizes.
- For immediate customer onboarding, manually create nodes with image preloaded via AMI that contains the image layers.
- Open support ticket with Docker Hub / auth provider and escalate.
I’ll start mirror-config and prebake AMI now.
maya.sre: Trying mirror: `docker pull artifact-mirror.internal/library/nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime` — success. Suggest adding a registry-mirror entry to container runtime config.
aj.infra: Patching cloud-init snippet (temporary) — will post diff:
```
# cloud-init excerpt
runcmd:
  - sed -i 's|https://registry-1.docker.io|https://artifact-mirror.internal|g' /etc/containers/registries.conf || true
  - systemctl restart docker
```
deploy-bot: Deploy started: infra/patches/add-registry-mirror -> env=eu-west-1 by aj.infra
ryan(oncall): spinning up 3 preloaded AMIs in eu-west-1 for immediate provisioning. Using bake job `ami-bake-gpu` with pre-pulled nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime. ETA ~20m.
kate.sre: Opened Docker Hub ticket #DH-12472 and pinged our partner contact. Excerpt from their response: "We're investigating a token service regression in eu-west-1, intermittent 401s. Will update in 30m." :frowning:
lucas.support: Notifying impacted customers: will send status update saying "GPU provisioning degraded due to upstream image registry auth errors." Keeping running clusters unaffected note.
ana.prod: (typo?)
ana.prod: I meant @ana.prod — please coordinate comms. We should include mitigation steps and expected ETA for fixes.
ana.prod: sorry for the noise, ignore (this was me testing copy)
ana.prod: Draft status update:
"We are investigating a problem affecting GPU node provisioning in eu-west-1. This is caused by intermittent authentication failures when pulling images from Docker Hub. We have enacted a temporary internal mirror fallback and are pre-baking AMIs to restore provisioning. ETA for full restoration: ~1 hour. No existing workloads on running nodes are affected."
ana.prod: Post to status page once incident is P1 and mirror is enabled.
ryan(oncall): Mirror fallback applied to autoscaler and cluster-init in eu-west-1. Autoscaler is now using `artifact-mirror.internal/library/nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime` if token fetch fails. First two new nodes reached Ready.
maya.sre: CI runners back to green for CUDA images after mirror change. Running a stress job for 15m to confirm stability.
aj.infra: AMIs baked and uploaded. Launching 6 nodes with preloaded images to catch up with pending autoscaler demand.
kate.sre: Docker Hub updated: "Root cause identified: auth proxy returning 502 under load; mitigation in progress. Token service will be patched shortly." They expect full rollback in eu-west-1 in ~45 minutes.
ryan(oncall): Next steps: keep mirror in place for 2 hours post Docker Hub fix; file a follow-up to remove temporary sed hack in cloud-init; create an infra RFC for a persistent fallback registry mirror for critical images.
lucas.support: Sent customer status update v1. Will follow up when we have Docker Hub confirmation.
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: infra/patches/add-registry-mirror -> env=eu-west-1 (success)
kate.sre: Metrics: node provisioning failures dropped from ~18/min to ~1/min after mirror and AMI rollout. Still monitoring.
maya.sre: CI stress looks stable — no more 401s in the last 12 minutes.
ryan(oncall): Handing over to @kate.sre for the night watch. Summary for handoff:
- Root cause: Docker Hub token service regressed in eu-west-1, intermittent 401/502 causing docker pull auth failures for images requiring token exchange (nvidia/cuda).
- Mitigation applied: 1) internal registry mirror fallback configured for autoscaler & cluster-init 2) prebaked AMIs launched to satisfy pending capacity 3) Docker Hub ticket opened and partner pinged.
- Impact: New GPU node provisioning delayed for ~1h for customers in eu-west-1; existing GPUs unaffected. Some CI pipelines were briefly impacted.
- Next actions for on-call: watch provisioning metrics, confirm Docker Hub full rollback, plan removal of temporary cloud-init sed once safe.
kate.sre: Taking over. I've added a checkpoint at +30m to reassess. Leaving incident channel open and will update status page when Docker Hub confirms resolution.
ryan(oncall): Thanks — leaving notes in the incident tracker (#INC-2026-042). Also uploading logs bundle to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-042/logs.tar.gz
kate.sre: Docker Hub just posted rollback complete: "Token proxy restored in eu-west-1 and auth requests are succeeding." I'll start phasing out mirror in 10m and test a dry run of direct pulls.
kate.sre: Dry run: `docker pull docker.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime` — success. Reverting autoscaler to default registry.
aj.infra: Reverted cloud-init sed; deployed cleanup patch to eu-west-1. Monitoring nodes for any regressions.
kate.sre: Observability: provisioning failures remain at ~0/min for last 15m. Marking this incident as mitigated. Will keep channel open for any late regressions.
lucas.support: Posting final customer update: "Provisioning restored; root cause was upstream Docker Hub auth instability. We implemented internal mirror fallback and prebaked AMIs to restore capacity. We're monitoring and will send follow-up once Docker Hub confirms root cause and remediation."
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P1 -> MITIGATED. Duration: ~1h 6m. Owners: ryan(oncall) -> kate.sre. Follow-ups: create RFC for registry mirror fallback; remove temporary cloud-init fix; postmortem assigned to ryan and aj.infra.
kate.sre: I'll run the postmortem template and capture timelines. Thanks everyone for the quick response. :rocket:
